children.text: Run one of these once. An agent in a terminal or another app then designs in the project of the folder it works in.
claude mcp add ultrapaint -s user -- ultrapaint mcp
codex mcp add ultrapaint -- ultrapaint mcp
‘Outside the editor’ leaves the end of Agents for Connections, under This computer: it is set once per machine.
The command’s state is a row with a status, not a sentence under the lines.
